t: You are looking at St Michael's Church, the principal Church of England parish church for Camden Town. The present building went up in the late nineteenth century, in the Gothic Revival style. It was designed by George Frederick Bodley and Thomas Garner, who were partners for much of Bodley's career. Bodley was a pupil of Sir George Gilbert Scott and worked with C. E. Kempe. He was also one of the founders of Watts and Company. So this is the work of a leading Gothic Revival architect, standing in the middle of Camden Town.
